description: This file contains utility functions related to minification, concatenation, backup, and restoration of JavaScript files in the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for excluding certain files, concatenating multiple JavaScript files into one, creating backup folders, minifying JavaScript files, reversing script changes, and backing up & processing script files.

methods.name: get_exclude_files
methods.description: Returns an array of file and folder paths to be excluded from processing, optionally prefixed by a provided string.

methods.name: ConcatenateFiles
methods.description: Concatenates grouped JavaScript source files into single files, with optional minification, and saves the results in the specified root directory.

methods.name: create_backup_folder
methods.description: Creates a nested directory structure for backups based on a specified path, ensuring all directories exist.

methods.name: CompressFiles
methods.description: Uses jsmin libraries to minify a JavaScript file, preserving license comments, and writes the minified content to a target path.

methods.name: reverseScripts
methods.description: Restores original JavaScript files from backups by copying them back to source locations.

methods.name: BackUpAndCompressScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively backs up JavaScript files and compresses them, skipping excluded files and directories.
